description:
## Description

"A speaker system that inherits the design philosophy of 901.A 25cm cone unit is used for the low range, and two 7.5cm cone units are installed for the high range.The low-frequency unit is installed facing the front, and the two high-frequency units are set in opposite directions with respect to a 45� diagonal line. With this asymmetric layout, the radiation pattern of the sound pressure energy spreads in the listening room in a well-balanced manner, so that the sound image does not deviate regardless of the position of the listener.One of the two tweeters facing the side wall is equipped with a deflector that adjusts the radiation angle of sound.In most cases, you can get the correct spread by normal position, but if you want more spread, such as a large orchestra, you can get more spread by setting it to the outside.The network is a dual-frequency crossover network."

description:
## Description

"A multi-drive 2-way speaker system designed to deliver 901sound at a relatively low cost.Two 20cm cone-shaped units are used for the low range and four 7.5cm cone-shaped units are used for the high range, each with an angle to create a unique layout.The network employs a crossover network with bypass capacitor.The structure of this network is such that the radiation energy of two of the four tweeters toward the outside is enhanced as the band becomes higher.This Bose'Ωs unique asymmetric directional characteristics allow non-diffusive high-frequency components to spread throughout the room, creating a well-balanced and wide-spread sound field.Depending on the installation site conditions, the output of the four tweeters can be switched to the same type (symmetrical type).Bose 601fits snugly against the back wall for a direct / reflective effect.In addition, three of the six drivers radiate acoustic energy upward, so that a balanced sound field can be obtained even when placed near a sofa or table.If there are no walls on the side, the control switch can be used to switch to the high-energy radiation pattern to obtain the correct balance."

name: 601II
description:
## Description

"A floor-type speaker system using technologies such as free space array and sub-port enclosure.The 601II uses a free space array system and has a unique unit layout.The free space array method is based on the know-how obtained at 901IV to make the indirect sound and direct sound energy balance the same as that of live performance. Five of the six units are mounted on the upper part of the enclosure. In particular, four tweeter units are installed in a 360� self-play space with no obstacles.By using this method, the reproduced sound is widely spread outside the left and right speakers, and conventional speakers realize an internal stereo sound image. In addition, by adopting the critical mounting angle of the unit derived from simulation of the venue and speakers, it is possible to radiate sound energy equally in all directions inside the room.The enclosure uses a unique sub-port system to limit the adverse effects of standing waves.In this method, each of the two woofers is equipped with an independent sub-enclosure, which is connected to the main enclosure through a sub-port. This sub-port controls the Q characteristic near the frequency which is easily affected by the standing wave. This sub-port reduces the middle and low band energy radiated to the front surface of the cone paper and guides the back pressure of the woofer to the main enclosure.In the main enclosure, the frequency is further adjusted, and the lower frequency is emitted from the main port located at the top.In the low range, 2pieces of 20cm cone type woofer using magnetic circuit of 2kg magnet weight are mounted.In order to improve the high-frequency reproduction capability of this unit, the damper and edge braking value are controlled. In addition, by installing two woofer units, the actual area of cone paper is doubled by ¥2, ensuring the low-frequency reproduction capability comparable to that of a large-diameter woofer.Four cone-type tweeters are installed in the high range.This unit uses special pulp with large internal loss and high Young'Ωs modulus to suppress the rapid attenuation of high-frequency characteristics.For the insulation material of the voice coil of each unit, special polymer material corresponding to the surface treatment of space rocket is adopted, and high input resistant design with excellent heat resistance and heat dissipation characteristics is adopted.A dual-frequency crossover network is used in the network section, and approximately one octave from 1.5kHz to 2.5kHz is received by both the tweeter and woofer.This prevents the point source effect, which causes fluctuations in the sound image by changing the sound unit depending on the band.The Shincom II computer developed in-house is used for the production of the 601II, and from the selection of parts to the product check, it is well managed."

name: 901WESTBOROUGH
description:
## Description

"A speaker system developed for the purpose of reproducing the impression obtained from music before the superiority and inferiority of physical characteristics are maximized.It is built on patent theories such as ""direct / reflective"", ""flat power radiation"", and ""active equalization"".The enclosure is an acoustic matrix enclosure (A.M. E.).The interior of the cabinet is precisely divided into nine equal parts to accurately reproduce the deep bass and reduce distortion. The dimensional error of each room is finished on a scale of less than 1/1000inch of the design value.This ensures uniform air volume and prevents the occurrence of standing waves.This eliminates the need for a sound absorbing material such as the cabinet of a typical speaker, making it possible to use all the internal niter acoustically.The ""resonance damping"" effect of the cabinet air, which is fixed for each unit, and the tuning of the bass reflex port mounted on the back, apply the damping to the front aftermovement of the cone paper and release the maximum acoustic energy while suppressing the amplitude.The bus recovery port (rear active air column) is arranged in three positions depending on the direction of the unit. It is arranged by calculating the energy efficiency, direction and phase consistency of the compressed air.In addition, the shape is designed based on the same hydrodynamics used for jet jets. While preventing turbulence caused by high-speed air jets, it has the ability to instantaneously send air at a speed of 100km / h. It realizes clear and responsive playback even at high volume.Nine 11.5cm cone type units are used for the speaker unit.In order to finish the unit uniformly, we are developing a computer program to control 126points to wind the voice coil of the unit as accurately as possible.By controlling even a small amount of adhesive, the impedance curve of the speaker that was considered impossible to align is made uniform.The speaker terminal uses a gold-plated screw terminal type.It has an active equalizer."

name: VCS-10
description:
## Description

"A center speaker with a thin design that pursues the reproduction of realistic dialogue.The unit is equipped with two 5.7cm cone type full-range units specially designed for dialogue reproduction and two 5.7cm cone type drivers for low band.The front is equipped with two drivers designed with an emphasis on middle and high sound reproduction to achieve clear speech reproduction. In addition, the rear of the front driver is equipped with 2drivers designed with an emphasis on low sound reproduction. This driver uses a strong magnet for low sound to avoid phase distortion with the front driver.Each unit has an anti-magnetic design with a canceling magnet and shield can.The unit layout employs an articulated array design with a unique angle that allows the middle and high sound emitted by the driver in front to draw an optimal radiation pattern, thereby improving the directivity.The cabinet structure is equipped with an independently developed compound loading system.In this system, the front chamber is sealed in order to transmit the vibration of the rear compound driver to the front driver and cause it to resonate. The vibration of the compound driver is coupled with the movement of the front driver, and resonance occurs with an extremely strong force near the resonance frequency, producing a powerful low sound. This reduces the volume of the enclosure previously required by approximately 30%.It is designed to emit low-frequency energy from the rear of the driver through the left and right ports. The inside of the cabinet is completely isolated from the left and right sides. The left and right ports have exactly the same characteristics. Moreover, the opening of the port is gradually flared so that low-frequency energy is emitted smoothly, and turbulence in the opening is suppressed, enabling efficient low-frequency playback.It is a compact size with a depth of 152mm and a thickness of 84mm so that it can be mounted on a CRT TV.In addition, by making it a matte professional gray color, it is considered to match with TV without feeling uncomfortable.Equipped with a smart protection circuit, a logic circuit composed of electronic components actively monitors the input signal, and when an input signal exceeding the allowable input is detected, the input signal is cut until there is no distortion component. The input signal is restored as soon as there is no distortion component."

name: AM-033
description:
## Description

"A subwoofer developed for the 101series and 1111series.The AM-033consists of a speaker and a dedicated network box.AM-033adopts the original Kusu timas theory (US PAT. 4549631).This system uses Bose'Ωs unique acoustic filter effect. The Woofer unit is mounted inside the cabinet and the acoustic energy is radiated outside in resonance with the mass of the air inside the port. Therefore, even if mid-range energy or strain occurs inside the cabinet, resonance does not occur because the frequency energy is different from the resonance frequency of the air inside the port.With this system, high-quality bass can be obtained, and the installation position can be freely chosen by filtering out high-frequency distortion that gives a sense of direction of the sound source.In the acoustic theory, all acoustic energy is emitted through ports arranged in front and back of the Kusu.This port is tuned to different frequencies before and after the woofer unit, so that near one tuning frequency, there is little output from the other port, and both outputs are multiplied between tuning frequencies, resulting in a wide range of flat bass.The unit is equipped with a 13cm cone shaped woofer with a highly responsive edge and damper.This unit uses a dual voice coil system. Two independent voice coils are wound simultaneously on one core to directly input both left and right channel signals.The cabinet has a cylindrical shape, and by matching the center of gravity of the structure with the center to receive the pressure of acoustic energy, generation of unnecessary resonance and standing wave is suppressed.It is made of lightweight and heat-resistant polycarbonate, making it possible to use in environments (below 120� C), such as car interiors in mid-summer.In consideration of the adverse effects on sound quality due to vibration and resonance, the AM-033uses a box-type network that is independent of the speakers.In addition, a dedicated one touch coupler is used for the output terminal to easy wiring.A special simple stand is included.In addition, various settings are possible by the separately sold ceiling / wall mounting bracket and stand."

name: MM-1
description:
## Description

"An active speaker system developed for near-field listening on desktops and other devices.In order to prevent this phenomenon, the MM-1is designed with the front baffle tilted by approximately 23degrees, enabling sound without the influence of reflected sound.The unit uses a 5.7cm cone type full-range unit.In addition, an aeroport is adopted in the cabinet to increase the low sound reproduction capability and to suppress port noise by the unique flare shape.Taking the characteristics of the ears into consideration, we have adopted PAP circuit which is Bose'Ωs proprietary patented technology.The PAP circuit automatically adjusts the volume balance according to changes in the human auditory sense, so that natural and powerful sound can be produced even at a low volume.Built-in power amplifier.Equipped with two input terminals, line mix is possible by operating the mixing volume on the front baffle.If you turn this volume to the left or right, you can play only one sound system.The power switch of the amplifier is equipped with a mute circuit to reduce pop noise.There are 2types of variations, MM-1B for black color and MM-1W for frosty white color."

name: AM-15
description:
## Description

"This is a 5.1ch speaker system that uses Kusu timmass technology.Bose'Ωs unique acoustic technology has been adopted. A 5.1channel configuration consisting of satellite speakers and a subwoofer section (acoustimass) that is in charge of frequencies below 200Hz allows both miniaturization and enhancement of the low Kusu range.Satellite speakerThe satellite speakers are wide-range satellite speakers.All five of these satellite speakers have the same playback capability, eliminating the need to adjust the level or tone quality of each channel. The ultra-compact design also provides a wide range of diffusivity.The unit uses a 6cm cone type full range unit with strengthened magnetic circuit.This unit has expanded the cone paper excursion to 9mm, which is unusual for this size, by reviewing the vibration system and adopting the baffle plate integrated structure.The direct / reflective theory has been introduced to achieve the ideal acoustic energy diffusion in concert halls in ordinary homes. The satellite speaker is a double-shot type that allows the orientation of the upper and lower speakers to be changed. By changing the orientation of each speaker, the balance between direct and indirect sound is controlled.Anti-magnetic countermeasure of the canceling magnet system is provided.A Kusu TimasThe Kusu Timmass has a built-in 120W power amplifier in order to reproduce heavy bass sound with sufficient power. In the amplifier section, bass signals for a total of six channels of L/C/R/SL/SR and LFE are synthesized and reproduced by the Kusu Timmass.In addition, the bass and LFE have their own independently adjustable volumes, and the LFE can be adjusted up to ¥9dB.Bose'Ωs unique base power summing technology is used to prevent phase interference between the front channel and surround channel bass energy.In the AM-15Kusu Timmass, this technology is further refined, and all six channels of phase signals are phase-matched by electronic circuits and synthesized. The synthesized bass signals are then played back by a 13cm long excursion woofer installed in the Kusu Timmass.The interior of the A Kusu Timus has a 3-room structure, and the high-frequency distortion generated from the cone paper of the speaker is cut by the air filter in 3chambers and 3ports, and flat and efficient low-sound reproduction over a wide band is realized.Equipped with Bose'Ωs unique P. A. P. circuit that automatically adjusts the sound balance so that you can hear the sound most naturally at any volume level. This gives you a natural sound balance even when you reduce the volume.In addition, since a compression circuit is installed, sound cracking does not occur even when there is an excessive input.The AM-15'Ωs built-in low-frequency power amplifier uses a G-class amplifier that uses separate power sources for normal volume and high output. This improves the energy conversion efficiency of the amplifier by approximately 30% and reduces heat generation by approximately 60%, making it smaller and lighter.In addition, a limiter circuit is mounted to protect the amplifier from destruction due to thermal runaway.OtherA smart protector protects the satellite speakers from excessive input.It uses a push-in connector that can connect the positive terminal and negative terminal simultaneously, eliminating the need for connection. It also comes with a dedicated cable that combines five cables into one. Each connector and cable clearly indicate which channel they belong to.The Kusu Timus also uses a square D-BUS connector that can be wired with one touch.There are 2color variations, black and white."
